summary: The milestone completed 13 experiments in 10.2 minutes, including 7 compute-bound experiments. The accelerator snapshot showed active compute, while the timing source could not explain phase costs or runner selection.

slowest_experiments.experiment: Owned 32K live code-carrying ARC tool preflight
Task-owned phase clock and three-family accelerator canary
Live ARC object-table fetch-on-demand paired comparison

bottlenecks_identified: The 4-minute corpus task and 3-minute transactional comparison formed the compute tail, but the supplied timing data gives no phase-level cause.
Disk modification-time reconstruction replaced live commit timing, so the record cannot separate launch, load, inference, and teardown costs.
The records do not link the three-model task to simultaneous model loading or runner identity, so a missed DualGPURunner dispatch cannot be assessed.
improvements_suggested: Record monotonic start, end, and phase timestamps in each experiment artifact instead of reconstructing timing from disk modification times.
Emit a launch receipt that joins task identity, simultaneous model count, runner identity, GPU assignment, and task-window utilization samples.
Add memory-aware placement advice that evaluates device_map='auto' for eligible multi-model launches without imposing a dual-GPU runner on single-model work.
Report the critical path separately from overlapped GPU work so the next retrospective can distinguish throughput from per-task latency.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add task-owned monotonic phase timing to every experiment artifact.
Make the dispatcher log simultaneous model count and the DualGPURunner eligibility decision before launch.
Join GPU utilization and memory samples to each compute task and use them for memory-aware placement.
meta_reflection: The GPU snapshot supports efficient accelerator engagement, not a compute-idle finding. No data available this milestone identifies why the longest tasks took their recorded time, verifies parallel model loading, or establishes a measurable savings percentage.
